newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos begins five-nation trip.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos begins five-nation trip.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos flew to India on Thursday at the start of a five-nation tour of south Asia and the Middle East to look for fresh markets and investments.
Ramos, with a large business delegation, will spend three days in India before going to Bangladesh (March 5-7), Pakistan (March 7-9), Qatar (March 9-10) and Bahrain (March 10-11).

One of the officials accompanying him is former Moslem rebel chief Nur Misuari, who signed a peace deal with the government last September and is now governor of a semi-autonmous Moslem region in the southern Philippines.

Ramos and Misuari are engaged in a campaign to attract foreign investors to develop the impoverished Moslem area and contain an insurgency still being waged by two breakaway Moslem groups demanding an Islamic state.

Four of the states Ramos is visiting - Bangladesh, Pakistan, Qatar and Bahrain - are members of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC) which helped mediate the peace accord between Manila and Misuari's Moro National Liberation Front.
Ramos said that in the Middle East, he will also be discussing the situation of 30,000 Filipinos working in Qatar and of the 25,000 others working in Bahrain.

A team of doctors is also accompanying Ramos in his first foreign trip since he underwent an operation in December for the removal of a cholesterol block in a vein in his neck which doctors said could have induced a stroke.
